findings.title: Inconsistent DVLP base-to-novel baseline
findings.claim: The two tables describe the same baseline ablation but give different aggregates
findings.check: Table16 per-dataset means82.29636/74.24727 and HM78.06489; Table3 lists79.61/71.63/75.41
findings.impact: Section 4.2 uses the ablation to verify the effectiveness of the core GI/ID/FG feature construction. The baseline controls component-gain attribution. The contradictory controls change GI-only HM gain from 2.68 to 0.03 points and full-model gain from 5.62 to 2.97, materially compromising this central empirical evidence. The true historical baseline remains unresolved; survival of architecture, efficiency and positive total gains does not resolve this dependency.
findings.counterevidence: A configuration or transcription difference could reconcile the tables but is not documented. Positive full-model gains under either baseline, the shared architecture and efficiency evidence survive. No raw-score fabrication or historical-run choice is inferred.
findings.repair_status: Scoped arithmetic verified; factual reconciliation pending
findings.core_dependency: Table 3/Table 16 baseline -> GI and full-model effect magnitudes -> Section 4.2 validation of the core three-feature construction.
operative_assumptions: Tables 3 and 16 label the same base-to-novel DVLP baseline over eleven datasets; no distinguishing configuration is disclosed
HM is computed from the displayed mean base and novel accuracy
